reason: A toolchain is available (axoloty-dev:latest, Swift 6.3.3 / ESP-IDF v5.4) and the firmware image builds, but no physical ESP32-C6 is attached to AXOLOTY_DEVICE_PORT and no MQTT broker is reachable, so the smoke protocol could not be flashed or run. A container can produce an image; it cannot flash one. Axoloty 0.8.1 started a new compatibility cycle on 39e1ec0662f6 and this profile has no device evidence for it, so it stays unqualified.
